title: Parity Catalog Entry
description: One Parity Catalog entry. parity/catalog.jsonl holds exactly one object of this shape per line. The catalog is the single machine-readable authority for scope, mapping, capability status, deviation and evidence (docs/specs/parity-verification.md). This document is the human/tooling contract; internal/catalog enforces the rules in Go without a JSON-schema runtime.

schema_version.description: Version of this entry schema. Bump in lockstep with $id/version and the manifest.

id.description: Stable unique identifier. The JSONL is sorted by this field for determinism.

upstream.description: Fixed Pi baseline provenance. At M0.3 the reference is at module granularity; #20/#21 refine it to files and symbols.

module.description: Upstream Pi module name, e.g. ai, agent, coding-agent, telemetry, tui, protocol, client, server.

commit.description: Pinned baseline commit; must equal the manifest baseline_commit.

reference.description: Upstream locator; module granularity at M0.3, file+symbol later.

mapping.description: Where the upstream artifact maps in Pig.

module.description: Pig module bucket, e.g. ai, agent, codingagent, telemetry, tui, protocol, client.

target.description: Go import path or symbol the entry maps to.

status.description: Capability Status lifecycle: inventoried -> scaffolded -> partial -> implemented -> verified, branching to deferred.

evidence.description: Repeatable verification material. Required (non-empty) when status is implemented or verified.

kind.description: Evidence kind, e.g. go-test, fixture, oracle, manual.

ref.description: Locator for the evidence, e.g. a test path or case id.

baseline.description: Baseline the evidence was captured against.

deviation.description: Approved deviation and the ADR authorising it.

partial.description: Required when status is partial: both supported and unsupported branches must be listed.

deferred.description: Required when status is deferred: must point to an ADR and a target milestone.

notes.description: Free-form clarification; never authoritative on its own.
